proposal:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one visual proposal sheet, NOT a finished website and NOT a production icon atlas.
Create a polished landscape art-direction sheet for five position emblems in the fantasy/cyberpunk collectible card game KALISTAR. This is a design proposal awaiting the player's approval.

Visual identity: sculpted painted silver-white motifs, finely bevelled warm copper edges, a tiny restrained pale-cyan energy inlay. Heroic fantasy craftsmanship with a very slight technological character. Existing Kalistar menu style is copper/silver sculpted emblems over dark jade. Strong clear silhouettes, broad readable strokes, little internal detail. No generic flat app icons, no enclosing circular medals, no Bootstrap badges, no rainbow role coding, no role-colored gemstones. The five shapes must remain distinguishable without color. Front view, clean optical centering, consistent visual weight and scale. Standalone emblems with breathing room, not five objects inside cards.

Composition: a restrained dark forest-jade matte background with a single thin copper rule, minimal editorial presentation. Five evenly spaced columns, no floating rectangular cards. Top small elegant Cinzel-like inscription exactly "POSTES KALISTAR". Main row: large emblems. Under each emblem a clear position code and smaller exact role label. Plenty of room between columns; no overlap. Lower portion shows the SAME emblems repeated at a realistic small UI size beside their P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 codes on one horizontal strip, headed exactly "EN INTERFACE". This smaller row is important: the silhouettes should still read clearly. No giant glowing effects, no busy backdrop, no invented UI descriptions.

Five columns left to right:
1. P1, label "TANK": a broad heraldic tower-shield, one clean vertical ridge and simple copper shoulders. Its silhouette reads protection and stability, not an equipped item.
2. P2, label "DPS PHYSIQUE": one bold diagonal silver blade with a small angular impact stroke; no crossed swords (the Arena menu already uses crossed swords). Dynamic, unmistakable physical assault.
3. P3, label "MIDDLE": a central round mechanical hub joined to three broad balanced branches, an elegant pivot/link emblem. Not a elemental crystal, not a potion, not a generic magic orb. It expresses the central versatile role.
4. P4, label in two short lines "DPS MAGIQUE" and "DISTANCE": one outward flying silver arrow/projectile passing through a thin open energy arc. Reads both ranged projection and magic; NOT exclusively a staff, spellbook, bow, or firearm. Pale-cyan trace restrained, silhouette remains readable without the trace.
5. P5, label "SUPPORT": two simplified curved silver hands cradling one small soft luminous spark, warm copper attachments. Express assistance to an ally, not exclusively healing: no medical cross, no heart shape.

All text must be spelled exactly as specified in French, readable cream-white serif labels. P codes remain text OUTSIDE the icon artwork. No changes to game rules or card art are depicted. No characters, no logo copied, no watermark. The output is ONE coherent concept board, five distinct simple emblems plus their small-scale preview.
atlas: Edit the approved KALISTAR position design sheet into a production TRANSPARENT icon atlas. Preserve EXACTLY the five large main-row emblem identities from the provided reference; no new motifs, no style redesign. Take ONLY those five emblems, left to right: the tower shield, the diagonal blade with impact shards, the three-pronged mechanical pivot, the arrow through an open energy arc, the paired hands cradling a light. Preserve copper outlines, silver body, original restrained cyan inlays, relative shapes and painted material. Remove ALL background, headings, labels, text, rules, ALL letters and numbers, and the entire lower repeated example row. Each emblem must be a clean standalone cutout with real transparent alpha, including open negative spaces between hands/branches/arcs; no black squares, no green background remaining, no broad glow halos. Arrange the five emblems in ONE horizontal row on a transparent landscape canvas, FIVE identical equal-width square cells, each emblem completely within its own cell with a generous transparent margin on every side (at least 12% of cell width). Same maximum optical height, balanced scale, front view. Keep the narrow soft energy trails needed for the P4 motif, contained inside its cell. No emblem or tiny spark may touch the image/cell bounds. No border/frame around cells. This is a clean 5x1 source atlas for 128px and 32px website icons, not a mockup. Exactly five emblems, zero additional objects.
